rows.commentary: 6.4: Asitha Fernando nails the yorker, beating Ben Duckett as he clears room and swings across the line into empty space.
6.5: Asitha Fernando offers a half-volley, and Ben Duckett leans forward to punch a blistering drive through the covers that leaves the fielders glued to their spots.
6.6: Asitha Fernando attacks the middle stump on a good length, and Ben Duckett whips the ball straight towards mid-on.
7.1: Dunith Wellalage floats it up around off-stump, allowing Tom Banton to push the ball down the ground to long-off.
7.2: Dunith Wellalage darts one into the left-hander, and Ben Duckett turns the spinning delivery safely to mid-wicket.
7.3: Dunith Wellalage targets middle with a flatter trajectory, and Ben Duckett tucks it neatly off his pads into the leg side.
7.4: Dunith Wellalage feeds the left-hander as Ben Duckett shuffles across with the spin, working it toward square leg for a leisurely single.
7.5: Dunith Wellalage loops a delivery onto middle stump, which Tom Banton solidly blocks right back to the bowler.
7.6: Dunith Wellalage delivers a flatter ball on middle that Tom Banton meets with an exquisite reverse sweep, splitting backward point and third man with surgical precision.
8.1: Dilshan Madushanka strays into the pads as Ben Duckett misses the flick, drawing an immediate wide signal from the umpire.
8.1: Dilshan Madushanka hits a good length on the pads, and Ben Duckett calmly tucks it away toward square leg for a single.
8.2: Dilshan Madushanka lands one on a good length targeting off and middle, prompting Tom Banton to dead-bat the ball toward the covers.
8.3: Dilshan Madushanka pushes a fuller delivery across the right-hander, met by a solid front-foot defense towards mid-off at 133kph.
8.4: Madushanka swings a hint of shape into Tom Banton, who tucks the ball neatly toward mid-wicket.
8.5: Creeping very full outside off, Madushanka draws Banton forward to mistime his drive straight to mid-off.
8.6: Banton stays rooted as Madushanka offers width outside off, slamming a gorgeous punch through the covers that races to the boundary.
9.1: Dunith Wellalage darts one through to Ben Duckett, who collects a comfortable couple of runs down to long-on.
9.2: Dot ball from Dunith Wellalage to Ben Duckett.
20.1: Dunith Wellalage floats one slightly short outside off, inviting Ben Duckett to punch it straight to the cover fielder.
20.2: Dunith Wellalage stays full outside off, snapping up a sharp return catch low to his left off his own bowling.
20.3: Dunith Wellalage targets middle and leg on a length, nudged softly into the mid-wicket pocket for a single.
20.4: Dunith Wellalage offers width outside off, sliced past short third man before Madushanka sprints across the deep to rescue the boundary.
20.5: Dunith Wellalage gets played firmly toward wide long-off by Tom Banton to rotate the strike.
20.6: Dunith Wellalage pushes his length full, squeezed straight back down the pitch by Ben Duckett.
21.1: Asitha Fernando drops it slightly short on middle and leg, dragged toward fine leg for a single.
21.2: Asitha Fernando digs it in as Ben Duckett pulls fiercely, stinging the fielder who flies right to intercept with one hand.
21.3: Asitha Fernando serves up a short and wide delivery outside off, beating Ben Duckett as he throws his hands through the line.
21.4: Asitha Fernando watches a pull shot travel toward wide mid-on where Shanaka's sliding effort leaks a second run.
21.5: Asitha Fernando pitches on a length around middle and leg, clipped smoothly toward mid-on for a quick single.
21.6: Asitha Fernando keeps one low on off, punched to mid-off before an aborted run sends Tom Banton scrambling back.
22.1: Dunith Wellalage floats it onto the pads, allowing Ben Duckett to clip it securely away into the leg side for a comfortable single.
22.2: Tom Banton marches down the pitch and launches Dunith Wellalage majestically over long-off for a towering maximum, bringing up England's hundred and fifty in style.
22.3: Dunith Wellalage pushes this full and straight delivery into off stump, and Tom Banton meets it solidly to defend into the off side.
22.4: Tom Banton reads the length around off and neatly bunts the ball out toward long-off to collect a single.
22.5: Ben Duckett plays a crisp drive straight down toward long-on to rotate the strike with a single.
22.6: Tom Banton works this slightly short delivery from middle and leg softly toward mid-on to pick up one more run.
23.1: Asitha Fernando digs this back of a length delivery into middle and leg, where Tom Banton nudges it wide of mid-on for a brisk single.
23.2: Asitha Fernando spears one in slightly short on middle and leg, and Ben Duckett tucks it smartly away through backward square leg.
31.6: Dunith Wellalage tosses it up, and Harry Brook dances down the track to launch it towering over deep mid-wicket for six.
32.1: Eshan Malinga delivers on a length around middle and leg, allowing Ben Duckett to clip it easily toward fine leg for a single.
32.2: Eshan Malinga bangs it in short, Harry Brook pulls toward deep square leg, and though the fielder gets hands to it, the ball pops over the ropes for six.
32.3: Eshan Malinga feeds the bat, and Harry Brook heaves it through mid-wicket to beat the fielder for a boundary.
32.4: Eshan Malinga angles it outside off, and Harry Brook guides it smoothly down to third man for a couple of runs.
32.5: Eshan Malinga pushes it full, and Harry Brook drives it down to wide long-on to rotate the strike.
32.6: Eshan Malinga drops it short, and Ben Duckett pounces, pulling it fiercely through mid-wicket to find the fence in a flash.
33.1: Dilshan Madushanka follows the retreating batsman with a fuller delivery on middle and leg, which Harry Brook flicks through mid-wicket for two.
33.2: Dilshan Madushanka watches Harry Brook advance down the wicket to whip the ball away toward wide long-on for a single.
33.3: Dilshan Madushanka drifts one onto the pads, and Ben Duckett clips it straight to the fielder stationed at short fine leg.
33.4: Dilshan Madushanka offers width outside off, prompting Ben Duckett to slap it toward deep extra cover where a diving save restricts them to two runs.
33.5: Dilshan Madushanka serves a short ball that Ben Duckett ruthlessly pulls straight to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
33.6: Dilshan Madushanka drifts one onto the pads at one hundred thirty-five kilometers per hour, allowing Ben Duckett to work it through square leg for a single.
34.1: Eshan Malinga offers up a full-toss on the leg stump, which Ben Duckett whips away to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
34.2: Eshan Malinga strays with another full toss on the leg side, and Ben Duckett premeditates his movement to comfortably scoop it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
34.3: Eshan Malinga targets the middle stump with a full delivery, and Ben Duckett tucks it down to the left of long-on for a single.
34.4: Eshan Malinga deceives Harry Brook with a slower cutter low full toss, forcing the batter to clip it behind square as his bottom hand comes off the bat for a run.
34.5: Eshan Malinga digs in a short delivery, and Ben Duckett displays sublime control to help it on its way over short fine and into the backward square leg boundary.
45.1: Asitha Fernando spears in a lethal yorker outside off that tails away from Will Jacks, who backs away entirely empty-handed.
45.2: Asitha Fernando strikes again with another pinpoint yorker as Will Jacks charges down the track and drags it back onto his own stumps for 30.
45.3: Asitha Fernando drops another pinpoint yorker onto middle and leg, allowing Sam Curran to whip it through mid-wicket for a single.
45.4: Asitha Fernando fires in a dipping low full-toss on the stumps that Jordan Cox squeezes out toward long-off for one.
45.5: Asitha Fernando delivers a full toss on the off-side with a hint of movement, which Sam Curran wrists smoothly to long-on.
45.6: Asitha Fernando caps off a brilliant four-run, one-wicket over as Jordan Cox fails to get underneath it and drives straight to long-off.
46.1: Eshan Malinga watches Jordan Cox drill a half-volley past extra cover, where a desperate hand slows it down just enough for the long-off fielder to cut it off.
46.2: Eshan Malinga clocks 142.5kph with a low full toss outside off that Jordan Cox sharply slashes away to sweeper cover.
46.3: Eshan Malinga serves up a low full toss that Sam Curran keeps his shape for and smashes powerfully down the ground for a boundary.
46.4: Eshan Malinga keeps this delivery away from Sam Curran, forcing the left-hander to simply drill it out to long-off.
46.5: Eshan Malinga pushes a very full delivery onto the leg stump, allowing Jordan Cox to whip it to the right of long-on and hustle back for two.
46.6: Eshan Malinga clocks 138.9kph with another very full delivery that Jordan Cox brings his bat down on to push toward long-on.
47.1: Asitha Fernando almost nails the yorker, leaving Jordan Cox to squeeze the low full toss down the ground for a single.
47.2: Asitha Fernando fires in another accurate delivery, forcing Sam Curran to jam the yorker out toward cover for one.
47.3: Asitha Fernando unleashes a 135.5kph near-yorker that Jordan Cox can only heave down to long-on for a single.
47.4: Asitha Fernando errs with a full toss that Sam Curran hoicks toward deep mid-wicket, where a disastrous dropped catch gifts a maximum.
47.5: Asitha Fernando steams in and serves it up to Sam Curran, who drills it down to long-on for a single.
0.6: Gus Atkinson digs a short-of-length delivery into the left-hander, who safely defends off the back foot.
1.1: Sonny Baker tails the ball into Avishka Fernando, who loses his balance on the back foot before managing to keep it out via an inside edge.
1.2: Sonny Baker targets outside off with an in-swinger, prompting a solid defensive block to cover from Avishka Fernando.
1.3: Sonny Baker provides width outside off, allowing Avishka Fernando to dab it down to third man off the outside edge for a single.
1.4: Sonny Baker bangs a short ball into the body that keeps low, catching Kamindu Mendis on the ribcage as he misses his pull shot.
1.5: Sonny Baker bowls short of length around off-stump, comfortably defended off the back foot to the covers by Kamindu Mendis.
1.6: Sonny Baker angles it in, Kamindu Mendis opts for a late withdrawal, and the ball clips the toe of the bat, trickling toward the slip cordon.
2.1: Gus Atkinson targets a hard length at eighty-eight miles per hour, swinging in from outside off as Avishka Fernando works it safely into the leg side.
2.2: Gus Atkinson sprays this delivery way down the leg side, leaving Avishka Fernando completely stranded before the umpire stretches his arms for the wide.
2.2: Gus Atkinson drops slightly short, inviting Avishka Fernando onto the back foot where he drops to one knee and whips it emphatically away to the deep square leg boundary.
2.3: Gus Atkinson beats the bat as Avishka Fernando misreads the line, taking a high impact on the back pad with no interest from the fielding side.
2.4: Atkinson angles it in, and Fernando strides forward to dead-bat it firmly into the off-side.
2.5: Gus Atkinson digs it short down leg, Avishka Fernando pulls uppishly behind square, and Sonny Baker charges in at fine leg to get both hands to a tough chance that ultimately hits the turf.
2.6: Gus Atkinson lands it on a good length around middle, and Kamindu Mendis confidently dead-bats it into the on side.
3.1: Sonny Baker unleashes a searing eighty-six miles per hour inswinging yorker that forces Avishka Fernando to scramble his bat down just in time while falling away.
3.2: Sonny Baker attacks the channel on a hard length, tailing in to find Avishka Fernando who defends solidly toward short cover.
3.3: Sonny Baker offers a half-volley outside off that Avishka Fernando drives firmly, though straight to the fielder at cover.
3.4: Sonny Baker shapes another sharp inswinger, allowing Avishka Fernando to turn it away and scamper through for a quick single toward the leg side.
14.1: Liam Dawson bowls a tossed up delivery to Avishka Fernando, who drives it down to long‑on for one run.
14.2: Liam Dawson delivers a loopy ball to Kusal Mendis, who pushes it down to long‑off for a single.
14.3: Liam Dawson bowls to Avishka Fernando, who drives it back to the bowler for no runs.
14.4: Liam Dawson sends a very full ball to Avishka Fernando, who pushes it away from his body back to the bowler, no runs.
14.5: Liam Dawson bowls to Avishka Fernando, who blocks it to the right of Dawson, who moves across and stops it in his follow‑through, no runs.
14.6: Liam Dawson delivers a quicker ball down the leg‑stump to Avishka Fernando, who gets a tickle down to short fine‑leg, no runs.
15.1: H Crocombe bowls a 132.5 kph delivery to Kusal Mendis, who stays on the back foot and keeps it out for no runs.
15.2: H Crocombe bowls to Kusal Mendis, who drops it in front of mid‑on and scampers for a quick single, making the run home.
15.3: H Crocombe bowls a slot delivery to Avishka Fernando, who clears his front foot and pumps it over wide mid‑on for four.
15.4: H Crocombe bowls to Avishka Fernando, who pulls an angled ball down to fine‑leg for a fourth boundary.
15.5: H Crocombe bowls a good length delivery to Avishka Fernando, who defends it to the on‑side for no runs.
15.6: H Crocombe bowls a full ball to Avishka Fernando, who whips it off his pads and picks up his third boundary of the over for four.
16.1: Liam Dawson bowls a tossed up delivery to Kusal Mendis, who clips it toward backward square leg for a single.
16.2: Liam Dawson delivers a ball that grips the surface slightly, and Avishka Fernando defends it into the off-side.
16.3: Liam Dawson bowls, and Avishka Fernando lofts a drive that is caught by Will Jacks at wide long‑off, ending Avishka's innings at 48.
16.4: Liam Dawson bowls to Pavan Rathnayake, who drives it inside out to mid‑off for a single.
29.2: Liam Dawson bowls a sharp swing, Dasun Shanaka is adjudged lbw as the ball hits the leg stump with no bat involved.
29.3: Liam Dawson tosses up a delivery around off, and Janith Liyanage plays it towards the bowler.
29.4: Liam Dawson's length around off is dragged through mid-wicket, earning Janith Liyanage a single.
29.5: Liam Dawson's ball on a length around middle and leg is pushed to long‑on by Pavan Rathnayake for a single.
29.6: Liam Dawson bowls a quicker delivery through the air on middle and leg, which Janith Liyanage redirects towards mid‑on, yielding no run.
30.1: Joe Root pushes a ball towards long‑on, and Pavan Rathnayake runs a single.
30.2: Joe Root tosses a delivery that Janith Liyanage lofts over deep square‑leg for a six.
30.3: Joe Root's toss‑up finds the slot, and Janith Liyanage smashes it over deep mid‑wicket for a six.
30.4: Joe Root drives the ball to long‑on, the bowler goes full, and the ball slides down the ground for a single.
30.5: Joe Root bowls a good length on the stumps, which is played straight to mid‑wicket, registering no run.
30.6: Joe Root delivers a loose ball down leg that Pavan Rathnayake sweeps to the fine‑leg fence for a four.
Janith Liyanage hits two consecutive sixes, SL 218/4 (32), chasing 387, 169 more required, with 15 runs off 8 balls.
31.1: Sam Curran's leg‑by‑es on a length around leg are nudged to the on‑side, earning one run.
31.2: Sam Curran bowls a good‑length ball around middle‑leg that Pavan Rathnayake punches to long‑on for a single.
31.3: Sam Curran’s lofted delivery to Janith Liyanage is snatched by Banton at long‑on, who slides to a clean stop and returns the ball for a single.
31.4: Sam Curran delivers a moon ball that Pavan Rathnayake sweeps clean to the deep backward square‑leg fence for four.
31.5: Sam Curran bowls a fuller slower ball outside off that Pavan Rathnayake drives through the off‑side, edges, and it races to the third‑man fence for a fourth.
31.6: Sam Curran bowls a back‑of‑a‑length ball on middle‑leg that Pavan Rathnayake clips through the leg‑side for a single.
38.6: Gus Atkinson delivers a high full toss to Pavan Rathnayake, a no‑ball for height, and a free hit is awarded.
38.6: Gus Atkinson bowls to Sahan Arachchige, who drives the ball to extra cover and completes a run with a dive.
39.1: Sonny Baker's half‑volley to Sahan Arachchige falls short of the gap, leaving the batsman unable to score.
39.2: Sonny Baker unleashes a wide four to Sahan Arachchige, who rocks back and slashes it to deep backward point.
39.3: Sonny Baker's back‑of‑a‑length delivery to Sahan Arachchige misses the scoop and goes over leg stump.
39.4: Sonny Baker bowls a better line and length to Sahan Arachchige, who drives it along the ground to long‑on.
39.5: Sonny Baker sends a fullish angling delivery to Pavan Rathnayake, who lifts it to deep extra cover for a boundary.
39.6: Sonny Baker bowls to Pavan Rathnayake, who whips a single to deep mid‑wicket, retaining the strike.
40.1: Gus Atkinson bowls to Pavan Rathnayake, who drives the full‑on ball along the carpet to sweeper cover.
40.2: Gus Atkinson bowls a 136.5 kph full delivery to Sahan Arachchige, who wrists it to long‑on.
40.3: Gus Atkinson delivers a slanting ball into Pavan Rathnayake's pads, who flicks it to deep backward square leg.
40.4: Gus Atkinson slides one in full at 138.8kph, and Sahan Arachchige slices an open-faced drive past point, scampering back for a brisk second as Jacks cleans up in the deep.
40.5: Gus Atkinson bowls a razor‑thin yorker to Sahan Arachchige, who rolls it to long‑on for a single.
40.6: Gus Atkinson unleashes a lethal yorker at Pavan Rathnayake, who edges it onto his front pad for no run.
41.1: Sam Curran snaps a yorker to Sahan Arachchige, who rolls it to long‑on for a single.
41.2: Sam Curran delivers a low full toss to Pavan Rathnayake, who chips it back but the ball slips from Curran's hand, allowing Arachchige to recover for no run.
41.3: Sam Curran bowls a fullish delivery to Pavan Rathnayake, who pulls a single to long‑on, deciding against a second run.
41.4: Sahan Arachchige does not score off Sam Curran.
43.5: Sam Curran’s delivery to Eshan Malinga is met with a solid back‑foot defense by the left‑hander, keeping the ball out of the scoring area.
43.6: Sam Curran’s ball to Eshan Malinga skids through, producing an inside edge to short fine leg, but the single is denied as Rathnayake refuses to take it.
44.1: Liam Dawson’s powerful sweep edges high to deep square leg, eluding the fielder and sending the ball over the boundary for four.
44.2: Liam Dawson extracts the crucial breakthrough as Pavan Rathnayake miscues the sweep straight to Sonny Baker at short fine leg, ending a magnificent 118.
44.3: Liam Dawson fires it past the tramlines outside off, drawing an extravagant, empty swipe from Asitha Fernando.
44.4: Liam Dawson delivers as Asitha Fernando strikes it down the ground to comfortably rotate the strike.
44.5: Liam Dawson fires it flat into middle and leg, where Eshan Malinga tucks it neatly into the mid-wicket region.
44.6: Liam Dawson claims his fourth as Asitha Fernando miscues a heave, allowing Tom Banton to charge across from long-on and clutch a brilliant sliding catch.
45.1: Sam Curran angles one in to shatter Eshan Malinga's leg stump, sealing a 55-run consolation victory for England.

preview.text: Sri Lanka and England meet in a one-day match at Gaddafi Stadium, where they have played 54 recorded one-day matches with Sri Lanka winning 28 and England winning 25. Sri Lanka won the toss and chose to bowl first. The usual first-innings score in the 32 recorded one-day matches at Gaddafi Stadium is 282, and the forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 29 degrees.

summary.text: England won by 55 runs. ENG made 386-5, Ben Duckett top-scoring with 167 off 132 balls; Asitha Fernando took 2 for 63. SL made 331-10, Pavan Rathnayake top-scoring with 118 off 77 balls; Liam Dawson took 4 for 49. Sides batting first at Gaddafi Stadium usually make about 282.
